description: Original service-independent deterministic civilization base-game orchestration, generated fair starting-site deployment, actor turns, city economy, worker orders, research, policies, diplomacy, trade, AI, four victory conditions with a configurable escalating culture race, loser-owned loss events, deterministic combat with percentage terrain/fortification defence, wounded defenders and flanking, healing by location, fog-safe combat previews, final score reveal with coarse public progress and fog-safe projections. Uses separately attributed HexMath through WorldMap. Synthetic balance and original gameplay code, no copied upstream ruleset/media, no claim of complete Unciv parity.
